summary: Iter 27 — Autonomous Outbound Sales Engine Phase 1. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests PASSED (1 deliberately skipped — public unsubscribe valid token requires server-side hash secret). Auth enforcement verified across all 6 endpoints (executive → 403, no-auth → 401, founder → 200). Dashboard shape (kpi+state+deliverability+segments+warm_leads+sent_today), state shape, pause/resume toggle, prospect add/list/duplicate-409, CSV upload (added=2, skipped=1 for bad row), AI score + LinkedIn-generate (correctly returned 200 — EMERGENT_LLM_KEY appears configured), LinkedIn mark-sent (connect+followup), mark-replied (neutral path), drafts list, run-tick, and public unsubscribe 403 on bad token all verified. Frontend: 14/14 critical UI flows passed via Playwright on live preview URL. Founder login → nav-outbound visible → tab-outbound renders with KPI strip, deliverability panel, pause toggle, Run Tick Now, Add Prospect form, CSV upload, view switcher, filters, prospects table all present. Add Prospect form successfully created a new prospect and refreshed list (5 rows). LinkedIn modal opens on row click and closes via close button. View switcher toggles between Prospects and Reply Drafts (drafts-empty state shown). Pause toggle flipped 'Pause engine' → 'Resume engine' as expected. Executive login (erin master key) does NOT see nav-outbound — RBAC scoping correct.

issues: KPI tile labels truncate on narrow widths ('TOTAL PRO…', 'SENT TODA…'). Consider shorter labels (e.g., 'TOTAL', 'SENT') or allow text wrap. Cosmetic only — values render correctly.
Nav links wrap awkwardly and overlap with the BodyIQ brand logo at viewport widths around 1280–1400px. Pre-existing global layout issue, NOT specific to the Outbound feature added this iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: outbound.py background scheduler (line 954-989): _standalone_process_queue calls make_outbound_router every tick to look up _TICK_HELPERS[id(router)], but each call creates a NEW router instance with a new id, so _TICK_HELPERS.get(id(router)) returns None and the scheduler returns 0 every tick. Manual /run-tick works (router has its own closure) but the auto 5-min loop is effectively a no-op. Recommend hoisting the tick helper registration outside make_outbound_router or passing a closure directly to background_scheduler_loop. Severity: HIGH — autonomous send is broken until manually triggered.

outbound.py /prospects/upload (line 661-711): Uses query params for auth_email/auth_token (transmitted in URL — appears in webserver logs / browser history). Functional but a security smell. Consider Header-based auth or multipart form fields for credentials in a follow-up.

outbound.py /prospects/linkedin-mark-sent (line 770-781): `which` query param accepts any value but silently treats anything other than 'connect' as 'followup'. Add an explicit check (raise 400 on invalid `which`) for robustness.

PortalOpsPage.jsx is now 2068 lines (>700 line guideline). Recommend extracting OutboundTab + sub-components (OutboundKPIStrip, DeliverabilityPanel, AddProspectForm, CsvUploadBox, LinkedinModal, ProspectRow, DraftCard) into /app/frontend/src/pages/portal/outbound/*.jsx to keep this file maintainable.

outbound.py mark-replied (line 783): `status = replied_positive if positive else (not_interested if positive is False else replied)` — this is correct but tricky. `positive=True` flows correctly; `positive=False` becomes 'not_interested'; `positive=None` becomes 'replied' (neutral). Worth a one-line inline comment for the next maintainer.
outbound.py public unsubscribe (line 929-946): On invalid token → 403; on missing email → 200 with `ok:false`. Inconsistent. Either both should be 4xx or both should be 200 with error payload.
